name: Google Cloud Bangkok Region (asia-southeast3)
notes: Google Cloud's first Thailand cloud region, launched 2026-01-21 with 3 availability zones in Bangkok; part of US$1bn Thailand investment announced Sep 2024 (Google's own data center campus is in Chonburi, outside this batch).

name: AWS Asia Pacific (Thailand) Region (ap-southeast-7)
notes: AWS's first Thailand cloud region launched January 2025 with 3 availability zones in Bangkok and surrounding provinces (some AWS campuses, e.g. Bo Win, are in Chonburi, outside this batch). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Azure Thailand Region (via True IDC / GSA02)
developer: Microsoft Corporation (colocation partners: True IDC, GSA)
notes: Microsoft's first Thailand Azure region announced May 2024 (~US$1bn); built via local partner facilities including True IDC (Bangkok/Samut Prakan) and GSA02 (Chonburi); Microsoft committed an additional US$1bn+ for 2026-2028 cloud/AI infrastructure. Status reported as under construction.

name: STT GDC Bangkok 1 (Hua Mak)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (Thailand) - JV with Frasers Property
notes: Launched Sep 2021 as Thailand's first/largest hyperscale carrier-neutral DC at the STT Bangkok campus in Hua Mak, central Bangkok; 23MW IT load, ~30,000 sqm, NVIDIA DGX-Ready certified, supports immersion and direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

name: STT GDC Bangkok 2 (Hua Mak campus)
notes: Third STT GDC facility in Thailand, within the STT Bangkok campus (Hua Mak); ~24MW IT potential; construction started 2025, expected online late 2026 / Q1 2027 (sources differ).

name: STT GDC Bangkok 3 (One Bangkok)
notes: Low-latency downtown node at One Bangkok (Wireless Road), ~2MW initial capacity opened end-2023, up to ~14MW when fully built out.

name: True IDC Midtown Ratchada
developer: True Internet Data Center (True IDC) / CP Group
notes: Existing True IDC colocation site in Ratchada, Bangkok; part of True IDC's 150MW+ national portfolio.

name: True IDC Midtown Pattanakarn
developer: True Internet Data Center (True IDC) / CP Group
notes: Existing True IDC colocation site in Pattanakarn, Bangkok.

name: True IDC 7th Data Center (Northern Bangkok)
developer: True Internet Data Center (True IDC) / CP Group
notes: Groundbreaking 2026-06-19 for True IDC's 7th AI-hyperscale data center in Northern Bangkok; >THB 6bn investment; scheduled to launch Q3 2027; supports air and liquid cooling, hyperscale compute.

name: Telehouse Thailand (KDDI) - Huai Khwang
notes: 12MW Bangkok facility in Huai Khwang district; BOI approved November 2025 with ~US$224m (THB 7.2bn) investment.

name: Empyrion Digital Bangkok
notes: 12MW Bangkok project (~US$140m); BOI approved March 2025.

name: Stellar DC (STECON Group + SC Zeus)
developer: Stellar DC (JV: STECON Group (TH) + SC Zeus Data Centers (SG))
notes: 25MW Bangkok data center, ~THB 8.1bn (US$260m); BOI approved January 2026.

name: Edgnex Bangkok (DAMAC/Edgnex + PROEN JV)
notes: Edgnex Bangkok in Rama 9 CBD, ~20MW planned capacity, developed through JV with Thai EPC firm PROEN.

name: TikTok/ByteDance Thailand data hosting expansion
notes: Multi-province data hosting expansion across Bangkok, Samut Prakan and Chachoengsao; ~THB 126.8bn ($3.6bn) approved by BOI in 2025, expanded to THB 842bn ($25bn) approval in May 2026.

name: Tencent Cloud Bangkok Region
notes: Tencent Cloud Bangkok region with at least two availability zones (Zone 1 and Zone 2). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Huawei Cloud AP-Bangkok region
notes: Huawei Cloud AP-Bangkok region confirmed via official documentation; Bangkok-based cloud infrastructure.

name: Alibaba Cloud Thailand (2nd data center)
notes: Alibaba Cloud launched its second Thailand data center in February 2025; operates at least two local DCs in the Bangkok area.

name: AIS Cloud (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure)
developer: Advanced Info Service (AIS) / Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
notes: Joint landing model between Thai operator AIS and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in Bangkok.

name: Siam AI Cloud (NVIDIA Cloud Partner)
notes: BOI-backed AI infrastructure expansion, ~THB 3.3bn (US$101m); exact Bangkok site not publicly specified.

name: NT Data Center Bangrak
notes: State operator NT's Bangrak (Bangkok) colocation facility.

name: TCC Technology (TCCT Empire Tower)
notes: Carrier colocation at TCCT Empire Tower, Bangkok (per DataCenterMap Bangkok listing).

name: NTT Bangkok 1 (Interlink Tower, Bang Na)
notes: NTT's Bangkok colocation facility in Interlink Tower II, Bang Na, Bangkok. (NTT's newer BKK2-BKK5 facilities are in Chonburi, outside this batch.)

name: GSA01 (GULF/Singtel/AIS JV) - Bang Phli
developer: GSA Data Center (JV: GULF 40%, Singtel 35%, AIS 25%)
notes: First fully liquid-cooled data center in Thailand, in Bang Phli, Samut Prakan; 25.6MW, commercial operations Q2 2025; deployed NVIDIA GB200 systems (announced late 2025); first phase of a broader ~120MW expansion.

name: True IDC East Bangna campus (Bang Sao Thong)
developer: True Internet Data Center (True IDC) / CP Group
notes: True IDC's East Bangna campus at 29 Bang Na-Trat Rd, Bang Sao Thong, Samut Prakan; in 2025 True IDC launched Thailand's first AI hyperscale data center here (Uptime Tier III TCDD/TCCF); part of True IDC's 150MW+ portfolio.

name: True IDC AI Hyperscale Campus (EEC)
developer: True Internet Data Center (True IDC; GIP-BlackRock partner)
notes: New-generation AI hyperscale campus in the Eastern Economic Corridor (Chonburi/Samut Prakan), THB 77bn (~US$2.4bn), groundbreaking April 2026, target up to 250MW, first phase 2027.

name: Bridge Data Centres BKK01 (Bang Phli)
notes: Bridge's BKK01 in Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (facility acquired from WHA Logistics in 2022); initially ~450kW, Bridge's larger Thai campuses (QHI01 up to 200MW) are in Chonburi.

name: ETIX Bangkok #1 / #2 (Bang Chalong)
notes: Edge data center cluster in Bang Chalong, Samut Prakan (~30km from Bangkok center); ETIX acquired 67% of the Genesis DC (2022) and operates Bangkok #1 and #2 there.

name: Equinix Thailand entry (BK1, Bang Phli)
notes: Equinix announced entry into Thailand (Oct 2025) with ~US$500m/THB 16bn over 10 years for its first two data centers; market directories cite first facility BK1 in Bang Phli, Samut Prakan; site details not officially disclosed.

name: Freyr Technology (Thailand) - Samut Prakan/Rayong
notes: Projects in both Rayong and Samut Prakan; BOI approvals January 2026 totalling ~THB 6.3bn (US$200m); partnership with Gorilla Technology for a SEA AI data center backbone (NVIDIA GPU-as-a-Service).

name: True IDC North Muang Thong
developer: True Internet Data Center (True IDC) / CP Group
notes: True IDC colocation facility at Bangkok Land Building, Muang Thong Thani, Nonthaburi; one of True IDC's established sites.

name: NT Data Center Nonthaburi 1 & 2
notes: State operator NT operates two data center facilities in Nonthaburi province (Nonthaburi 1 and Nonthaburi 2).

name: DAMAC Digital NextGen DC (Nava Nakorn Industrial Estate)
developer: NextGen Data Center and Cloud Services (DAMAC Digital / Edgnex)
notes: 84MW hyperscale facility at Nava Nakorn (Navanakorn) Industrial Estate, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani; THB 26.7bn (~US$826m); BOI approved November 2025.

name: Zenith Data Center and Cloud Services (Nava Nakorn)
developer: Zenith Data Center and Cloud Services
notes: 200MW hyperscale project reported in Nava Nakorn Industrial Zone, Pathum Thani (per IDCNOVA); ~THB 54.9bn (US$1.7bn); BOI approved November 2025 (Blackridge lists location as undisclosed).

name: Khlong Luang / Khlong Nueng data center cluster
notes: Khlong Nueng (Khlong Luang district), Pathum Thani hosts ~33 listed data center facilities per DataCenters.com directory - established colocation cluster north of Bangkok, adjacent to Nava Nakorn Industrial Estate.
